specs.英文简介: AB Hela-Kameror was a Swedish camera maker, a company set up in Uppsala, Sweden by photographer Lars Henrik Larsson; the company name presumably from his name (HeLa).[https://www.uppsalaindustriminnesforening.se/hela-kameran/ Hela-Kameror page] at [https://www.uppsalaindustriminnesforening.se/ Uppsala Industriminnesforening] (Uppsala Industrial History Society - in Swedish).
